steps.en: Paste the one-line launcher into PowerShell and accept the UAC prompt
steps.zh: 把一行启动命令贴进 PowerShell，同意 UAC 提权

steps.en: Downloads the latest release to %TEMP% and relaunches itself as admin in Windows PowerShell 5.1
steps.zh: 把最新发布版下到临时目录，以管理员身份重新启动

steps.en: Tick the apps to remove and the tweaks to apply, or pick Default Mode
steps.zh: 勾选要删的应用和要改的设置，或直接选 Default Mode

steps.en: Backs up the registry values it will touch; Default Mode also makes a restore point
steps.zh: 先备份要改动的注册表值，默认模式还会建还原点

steps.en: Removes apps via Appx/WinGet, imports its .reg files, restarts Explorer
steps.zh: 用 Appx/WinGet 卸应用、导入自带的 .reg 文件、重启资源管理器

value.en: Preinstalled apps, ads, Copilot and telemetry are gone without hunting through Settings page by page — with a registry backup to roll back from
value.zh: 不用一页页翻设置、一个个卸应用，预装软件、广告、Copilot 和遥测就清掉了，还留着注册表备份可以回滚

sources: https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat Scripts/Get.ps1 (downloads releases/latest zipball to $env:TEMP\Win11Debloat, Start-Process powershell.exe -Verb RunAs)

https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat .github/CONTRIBUTING.md — High-Level Architecture (Regfiles, Appx / WinGet); wiki Command-line-Interface (-SkipExplorerRestart: script restarts Explorer by default)
